description: Cancel a booking made through Canopy. The appointment is called off in the business's calendar right away and the customer is emailed. This cannot be undone: confirm with the customer before calling. An appointment that has already started cannot be cancelled here. Needs the manage_token that came back with the booking_id.

booking_id.description: booking_id of the booking to cancel (from request_booking or get_request_status).

manage_token.description: manage_token returned with that booking_id (by request_booking when the booking was created, or as booking_manage_token by get_request_status).

reason.description: Short reason for cancelling, if the customer gave one.

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
